title: The Lost Dog
lines: Omar got a dollar from his gran.
He ran to the shop by the barn.
He was going to get a big red kite.
Then a dog ran in with a red collar.
It had no one with it and no home.
Omar called out, but the dog ran off.
He sat down and held out his hand.
The dog came back and sat by him.
Omar took it to the vet by the shop.
The vet read the tag on the collar.
She made a call. Then they had to wait.
A sailor came in. "That is my dog!"
He gave Omar a dollar for his help.
Now Omar had two. He got the kite.

questions.ask: What was Omar going to get with his dollar?
questions.listenFor: A big red kite. It is in the third line, before the dog turns up.
The tag on the dog's collar. Note how the -ar and -or on the ends both say er.

questions.ask: Was it fair of the sailor to give Omar a dollar? Why?
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. You want a reason, not a right choice.
